leakage_signals: Missing preference weights for cost versus late-night and morning travel convenience
Missing importance of nearby dining variety
Cancellable queen availability is not verified for any listed property
verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates because the query does not weight savings, a short late-night post-reception drive, the Tuesday-morning drive, dining variety, or balanced travel times. A is defensible for the lowest rate and roughly equal drives; B for the very short late-night trip and slightly lower price; D for the short Tuesday trip and stronger nearby dining; and C if minimizing the longer leg and having nearby restaurants outweighs its added parking cost, assuming the total remains compliant. Also, cancellable queen availability is required but not confirmed for any result.
